title: Removing the Torsion-free Hypothesis in a Positivity Theorem on Deligne-Mumford Stacks
summary: We remove the torsion-free hypothesis from a positivity theorem of Casalaina-Martin and Zhjeqi, answering a question of them. The main result of this paper was obtained using generative AI, particularly ChatGPT 5.5 Pro and the Danus system.
